title: Gastroenterologist visit
what: A doctor who treats the stomach, bowel, liver, gallbladder, and pancreas.
why: For belly pain, heartburn, nausea, bloating, constipation or diarrhea, or abnormal liver tests.
tell_doctor: What bothers you, when, and after what
How your stools and weight have changed
What medicines you take, including painkillers

prepare.title: Diary
prepare.text: For a few days, write down what you ate, when it hurt, and what your stools were like.

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Bring results of upper endoscopy, colonoscopy, ultrasound, and blood tests, if you had them.

bring: Past test results, discharge papers, and reports
A list of your medicines, or the packs themselves
steps: The doctor asks about your symptoms and diet
Your tongue and skin are checked
Your belly is felt while you lie down
Blood tests, an ultrasound, an endoscopy, or treatment are ordered
feel: Feeling the belly may be a little unpleasant if it hurts there
after: The doctor will give you diet advice and prescriptions
Check the prep for any ordered tests in advance
red_flags: Vomiting blood or material like coffee grounds, black stools, or severe belly pain: call emergency services

faq.a: Usually not for the visit. If an ultrasound or endoscopy may be done the same day, check with the clinic.
Past test results, your medicine list, and notes on diet and symptoms.

reminders.text: Gastroenterologist visit tomorrow. Bring your test results and medicine list.
